notes: KNOWN BUG (weaker than printed), fails today. Furious Rise: 'At the beginning of your end step, if you control a creature with power 4 or greater, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card until you exile another card with Furious Rise.' With the 5/5 out, seat 0's end step exiles Alpine Watchdog (that part works: furious_rise_exiles_with_a_big_creature.json). On seat 0's next turn the Watchdog may be cast from exile, so the menu must offer 'cast:dog'. It does not: the second sentence is suppressed at assembly (compiler._is_result_anaphoric_cast_permission, KNOWN-GAP 'play permission') because the engine has no permission to play a card from exile (DESIGN_ATOM_ONTOLOGY R5-2 PERMIT_CAST, never implemented), and its window, 'until you exile another card with Furious Rise', is an event-ended duration with no carrier (R5-8, divergence D15). docs/BACKLOG.md.
